title: Launch sequence
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: Oversized mixed-type messages and high-contrast graphics animate on black. White fragments surround a large Filler word; cookbook and creator references tilt and change scale. Serif, pixel-like, and bold lettering alternate throughout the promotional sequence.
learning_candidate: Kinetic typography can communicate a product promise before interface detail is introduced.
